summary: MGE Energy, Inc. filed Form 8-K Items 8.01 and 9.01 on August 21, 2026, disclosing a routine dividend increase rather than a special situation. The board approved a 7.0% rise in the quarterly dividend to $0.5083 per share, payable September 15, 2026, to holders of record September 1, 2026, lifting the annualized rate to $2.0332 and marking a 51st consecutive annual increase. No transaction, stake, premium, advisor, financing, or regulatory clock is referenced.
